item.title: 🔥 COMPLETE Character & Encoding Stress Test Item 🔥
item.description:
This is a CDATA block, testing unencoded HTML and reserved characters:

  1. Unencoded HTML: Bold text and italic text.
  2. Unencoded XML Reserved: The expression "A & B < C > D" and a direct quote "He said 'Hello'".
Testing Standard XML and Numeric HTML Entities (The XML-Safe Fix!): XML: & (Ampersand), < (Less-than), > (Greater-than), " (Quote), ' (Apostrophe). HTML: © (Copyright), ® (Registered), ™ (Trademark), € (Euro), £ (Pound), ¥ (Yen). Mathematical: √ (Square Root), ∑ (Summation), ∫ (Integral), ∞ (Infinity). Punctuation/Typography: – (En Dash), — (Em Dash), … (Ellipsis). Testing Global Unicode Characters (UTF-8): **French (Accents):** Ça va bien ? Être, île, garçon. **German (Umlauts):** Schön, Füße, Straße. **Nordic/Other Latin:** Ø, Å, Æ, Ð, Þ. **Greek:** $\alpha, \beta, \gamma$ (Alpha, Beta, Gamma). **Cyrillic (Russian/Ukrainian):** Здра́вствуйте (Zdravstvuyte). **Asian Scripts (Japanese/Korean):** 寿司, 김치, 漢字. **Arabic/Hebrew:** مرحباً, שלום. **Emoji/Symbols:** ⚡️, 💯, 𝄞, ᛟ, ⌘, , 🎉 (Party Popper).
